design_decisions.decision: Extracted _write_alert_rows helper from _alert_writer to keep nesting readable; rejected keeping everything inline in one 50-line function.
Unexpected writer error sets failed=True so the loop backs off ALERT_FAILURE_BACKOFF_SECONDS; rejected immediate retry (could spin on a persistent fault).
Real-DB backfill failure forced by pre-creating a watchlist table without created_at (no monkeypatching); rejected patching asyncpg.
Rate-limit uses time.monotonic accessed as app.db.time.monotonic so the test patches only that; first drop warns immediately.
Opt-out (flag false) skips loads and availability check; Database.connect still runs (so workers start if a URL is given). Empty DATABASE_URL with flag true fails (user decision B).
Known-issue numbers renumbered after deletions (issue 5 became 4, 7 became 5, 8 became 6); heading changed from "not fixed" to "(from T008 review)".
